categories.main_business_segments: US Foods operates as a single business segment focused on the marketing, sale, and distribution of fresh, frozen, and dry food and non-food products to foodservice customers across the United States. The company manages its business as one operating segment, leveraging standardized processes, shared systems, and a national scale with local execution. Its offerings include a broad assortment of products and value-added services tailored to various customer types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: US Foods relies on a sophisticated logistics and distribution network, including 70 distribution facilities, 86 cash and carry locations, and a fleet of approximately 6,500 trucks. The company utilizes advanced e-commerce and mobile technology platforms for personalized ordering and business analytics, and has implemented warehouse selection technology and process enhancements to improve efficiency. Product innovation is driven through programs like Scoop™ and Serve Good®, focusing on on-trend, sustainable, and private label products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves approximately 250,000 customer locations, including independent restaurants, chain restaurants, healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, educational institutions, and government entities. Its primary target markets are independent restaurants, healthcare, and hospitality, which value broad product offerings and value-added services. Group purchasing organizations (GPOs), especially in healthcare and hospitality, account for a significant portion of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: US Foods operates nationwide in the United States, with distribution and retail facilities in nearly every state. Its network includes over 170 facilities and a significant presence in the West and Northwest following the Smart Foodservice acquisition. All operations and employees are based in the U.S.
categories.supply_chain_position: US Foods is a downstream operator in the supply chain, acting as a broadline foodservice distributor. It sources products from approximately 6,000 suppliers and delivers them to end customers such as restaurants, healthcare, and hospitality providers, as well as retail and government entities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategy, 'GREAT FOOD. MADE EASY.™', emphasizes differentiation through product assortment, customer experience, and innovation. Key initiatives include expanding private label penetration, developing sustainable and on-trend products, enhancing technology-enabled customer solutions, and continuous operational improvement. Acquisitions, such as Smart Foodservice, support growth and strategic priorities, while R&D focuses on menu innovation, sustainability, and digital tools.
categories.revenue_model: US Foods generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of food and non-food products to foodservice customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of goods, with additional income from value-added services and technology solutions. The company also operates cash and carry retail outlets and offers e-commerce ordering platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: US Foods is one of the leading national broadline foodservice distributors in the U.S., competing with Sysco, Performance Food Group, Gordon Food Service, and numerous regional and local distributors. The company differentiates itself through its broad product assortment, value-added services, technology solutions, and strong focus on independent restaurants and private brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2022, US Foods reported net sales of $34.1 billion, gross profit of $5.5 billion, and net income of $265 million. The company experienced 15.5% year-over-year sales growth, driven by inflation and increased case volume, particularly in independent restaurants and hospitality. Adjusted EBITDA was $1.31 billion, reflecting a strong recovery from pandemic impacts and ongoing operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: US Foods emphasizes its ability to provide a comprehensive, innovative, and high-quality product assortment, supported by value-added services such as business consulting, menu innovation, and technology solutions. Its omni-channel approach, private brand portfolio, and focus on customer efficiency and profitability create strong differentiation, particularly for independent restaurants, healthcare, and hospitality customers.
